about: Get a 30-day multiple-entry visa to enter the UAE by land as a truck driver.
note: Requirements read from the official ICP service page on the checked date. ICP fills the form in from the person's records after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Truck driver visa, 30 days. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Multiple entry through land entry points
Passport valid for at least 6 months
The applicant must show they work in cargo transport in the UAE
documents: Copy of the truck ownership document
Notarised power of attorney if the truck belongs to another sponsor
ID of the driver depending on nationality: Iraqi residence card, Pakistani, Afghan or Iranian ID
channels: ICP Smart Services website or ICP Smart App (sign in with UAE PASS)
